notes: 39.2.10 is a visual-only ghost-dock polish on the validated 39.2.9 hover-chrome window model.
The global bottom Administrator dock is deliberately very faint at rest, reveals on dock hover/focus, and gives full contrast only to the directly hovered control.
The dock keeps its exact position, hit targets and actions; opacity does not disable pointer interaction and no layout shift is introduced.
Local operational window hover chrome from 39.2.9 is preserved unchanged.
Atlas Math Core retains the 39.2.8/39.2.9 contract: Classic docked behavior, medium right-side detached window, native Dessus/Latéral/Réduire controls and explicit maximize.
Window layout storage intentionally remains erith_admin_portal_39_2_9 because 39.2.10 changes only visual dock opacity and should not reset the operator layout.
No market, chart, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Memory, Bridge, Ollama, WebSocket, timer or business-state behavior is changed by this build.
